description: List the Treasury federal accounts that funded an award, with the amount obligated from each and the funding agency behind it. This is the award → appropriation link: each row returns federal_account (AGENCY-MAIN format, e.g. 080-0120) to chain into usaspending_get_federal_account for the account budget detail. The award_id must be a generated_unique_award_id — from usaspending_search_awards (generated_internal_id field) or usaspending_get_award. Distinct from usaspending_get_award account_obligations_by_defc, which breaks funding down by Disaster/Emergency Funding code rather than by account. An award_id that does not exist returns an empty list rather than an error.

award_id.description: Award generated_unique_award_id (e.g., CONT_AWD_GSFC0198106DNAS526555_8000_-NONE-_-NONE-) — use generated_internal_id from usaspending_search_awards or generated_unique_award_id from usaspending_get_award

name: usaspending_get_award_federal_accounts

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `api_unavailable`: USAspending.gov API is unreachable or returns an error. `api_timeout`: USAspending.gov did not respond before the request deadline elapsed. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

has_next_page.description: Whether there are more pages of funding accounts

notice.description: Recovery hint when results are empty — the award_id may not exist or may have no account linkage. Absent when results are present.

count.description: Total funding accounts across all pages

has_next.description: Whether there are more pages of results

items.description: Federal account that funded this award, with obligation and funding agency

federal_account.description: Federal account code in AGENCY-MAIN format (e.g., 080-0120) — pass to usaspending_get_federal_account as account_code for the account budget detail

funding_agency_id.description: Internal USAspending database ID of the funding agency — not the toptier code accepted by usaspending_get_agency

funding_agency_slug.description: Funding agency slug (e.g., "national-aeronautics-and-space-administration") — pass to usaspending_get_agency as agency_slug

funding_toptier_agency_id.description: Internal USAspending database ID of the funding toptier agency — not the 3-digit toptier code accepted by usaspending_get_agency

total_transaction_obligated_amount.description: Amount obligated to this award from this federal account in USD

totalCount.description: Total number of funding accounts across all pages (when available)

title: Get Award Federal Accounts
